title: Page-check CLI viewport argument hardening
summary: This iteration hardens the daily page quality CLI so positional viewport arguments from direct Node calls and npm-run PowerShell forwarding are parsed as viewports instead of output directories.

degraded_sections.message: The real 2026-06-29 page-check still reports the existing community_cards_reader_facing degraded check, but no blocking checks are present and this iteration does not modify community card rendering.

lessons.lesson: Package-script argument forwarding on Windows can reshape comma-separated viewport input into one whitespace-separated token.
lessons.evidence: The npm wrapper forwarded `1280x900,390x1200` to the script as a single positional token `1280x900 390x1200`; the parser previously treated that token as `outDir` and fell back to the default mobile viewport.
lessons.recommended_action: Normalize viewport lists by both comma and whitespace before positional outDir/output inference.

lessons.lesson: CLI hardening should be verified through the same page-check path used for source-first public quality gates.
lessons.evidence: The focused E2E builds the deterministic daily site, invokes `scripts/check-daily-page.mjs`, reads its JSON output, and asserts viewport widths `1280` and `390`.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep page-check invocation shapes covered in E2E when package scripts become part of the publish runbook.

lessons.lesson: Explicit flags must remain authoritative while positional inference becomes more forgiving.
lessons.evidence: `--date`, `--viewports`, `--out`, and `--output` continue to work in direct validation, while positional npm-run invocations now use the requested viewports.
lessons.recommended_action: Add future CLI options through `parseArgs` first, then extend positional inference only for backwards-compatible shorthand.

followups.action: Proceed to the next source-first roadmap slice only after this page-check CLI fix is merged, so later visual/page gates use stable viewport inputs.
